Theorem
[Li--Yau differential Harnack estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0334 ↗ def:chow-ii-ch16-heat-log-density 1. ch16:16.1\group Heat Harnack

If $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$, then every positive heat solution satisfies \[ \partial _\tau f+|\nabla f|^2-\Delta f+\frac{n}{2\tau }=0, \qquad \Delta f-\frac{n}{2\tau }\le 0. \] Consequently, for $\tau _2>\tau _1$, \[ f(x_2,\tau _2)-f(x_1,\tau _1)\le \frac{d(x_1,x_2)^2}{4(\tau _2-\tau _1)}. \]
Proof

\sketch The Bochner formula applied to the equation in Definition 1, followed by the scalar maximum principle, gives the differential inequality. Integrating it along a space-time path and minimizing the weighted kinetic energy gives the last display.

□
